map.DES / 3DES 加密解密 使用指南: DES / 3DES Encrypt and Decrypt User Guide
map.3DES 对明文做 加密→解密→加密（三把 56 位密钥），强度约 112 位；: 3DES applies encrypt→decrypt→encrypt to plaintext (three 56-bit keys), giving about 112 bits of strength; single DES has been broken by brute force. …
map.DES 与 3DES（Triple DES）双向加解密，同一入口可切加/解: Two-way encryption and decryption for DES and 3DES (Triple DES), with the same entry point toggling encrypt/decrypt
map.支持 ECB 与 CBC 两种分组模式，可指定密钥与初始向量: Supports both ECB and CBC modes, with key and IV configurable
map.输出可在 Base64 与十六进制之间切换，便于贴进配置文件或日志: Output switches between Base64 and hex for easy pasting into config files or logs
map.纯前端运算，密钥与明文不上传: Pure front-end computation; keys and plaintext are never uploaded
map.兼容老旧系统或教学分组密码；新系统勿用 DES。: Compatible with legacy systems or teaching group passwords; do not use DES in new systems.
map.维护老系统时解密历史数据：银行、社保等存量系统里仍有 3DES 加密的记录，需要: Decrypting historical data when maintaining legacy systems — banks, social security and other existing systems still hold 3DES-encrypted records that must be supported to migrate.
map.在算法选择处确认是 DES 还是 3DES：老旧系统多为 3DES，选错解不出原: Confirm at the algorithm selector whether it is DES or 3DES — legacy systems are mostly 3DES, and choosing wrong yields undecipherable output
map.选择与对方约定的分组模式（ECB / CBC），CBC 还需填初始向量 IV: Choose the agreed block mode (ECB / CBC); CBC also needs the IV initialisation vector
map.填入密钥（DES 8 字节、3DES 24 字节），解密时密钥必须与加密时完全一: Enter the key (DES 8 bytes, 3DES 24 bytes); the decryption key must be exactly the same as at encryption
map.粘贴密文或明文，点「加密」或「解密」: Paste the ciphertext or plaintext and click "Encrypt" or "Decrypt"
map.把结果按 Base64 或十六进制复制回原系统验证能否对接: Copy the result back as Base64 or hex into the original system to verify integration
map.56 位密钥空间小，现代算力可数小时穷举。: The 56-bit key space is small enough that modern computing can brute-force it in hours.
map.3DES 用三个密钥做三次 DES，有效密钥长度约 112 位，比 56 位的: 3DES runs DES three times with three keys, giving an effective key length of about 112 bits — far stronger than 56-bit DES, and it served as a transitional scheme. But its block is only 64 bits, so it faces the Sweet32 birthday attack on bulk data, and it is slow; NIST has deprecated it and new systems should use AES directly.
